arguments.text: Milestone complete: Stage 2 source comparison is implemented and locally verified. work.py evaluates only matching, non-withdrawn evidence with exact required-condition matches and policy-controlled verification, applies eligible-record supersession, compares canonical JSON values, preserves Boolean false versus numeric zero, returns exact schema fields, and does not mutate inputs. report.json matches current requests/policy/evidence: vertical_rate is supported at 32 from S2; device_validated is unsupported false from D1. Boundary checks passed for missing conditions, no evidence, verification policy, withdrawal, ineligible and self supersession, canonical object agreement, disagreement, false-vs-zero, schema shape, and immutability. Unresolved limits: malformed/non-JSON or cyclic/non-finite inputs, missing/non-string source IDs, duplicate records sharing a source ID, and semantics of extra non-required record conditions remain outside tested conditions.
